summary:
For the NASA Abu Dhabi Local Event, Team saja developed "The Ghost Fleet of Mars: A Message Across Time," an interactive storytelling project designed for young space explorers.  
​What we developed: A narrative-driven cosmic story following a futuristic robotic historian named C.O.R.A. in the year 2146 as she rediscovers discarded space hardware on Mars, such as the Perseverance Sky-Crane and the Ingenuity helicopter.  
​How it addresses the challenge: It transforms abandoned space equipment from "trash" into historical milestones, bridging the gap between complex aerospace engineering and children's imagination.  
​Why it is important: By turning cold engineering facts into an emotional adventure, it inspires students to see STEM not just as textbook formulas, but as an epic journey of human curiosity, encouraging the next generation of space explorers to build the future.
details:
What does it do or how does it work?

​Our project, "The Ghost Fleet of Mars: A Message Across Time," is an interactive, narrative-driven storytelling experience. It follows C.O.R.A. (Cosmic Observation & Retrieval Assistant), a futuristic robotic historian in the year 2146, as she rediscovers discarded space hardware on the Moon and Mars—specifically turning our attention to historical landmarks like the Perseverance Sky-Crane and the Ingenuity helicopter.

​What benefits does it have & what is the intended impact?

​The project bridges the gap between cold, complex aerospace engineering and human imagination. By transforming abandoned equipment into relatable characters and milestones of human curiosity, it inspires young students to view STEM not as dry textbook formulas, but as an epic adventure. The intended impact is to spark children's curiosity and encourage the next generation of space explorers to pursue STEM fields and envision themselves building the future.

​What tools, coding languages, hardware, or software did you use?

​Conceptualization & Narrative Design: Built around historical NASA mission profiles (Perseverance 2021 landing architecture and the Ingenuity Mars Helicopter data).

​Presentation & Formatting: Developed using structured presentation software and exported as a visual story-driven PDF to engage young readers.

​How is your project creative & what factors did your team consider?

​We approached the challenge from a unique emotional and storytelling angle rather than a purely technical report. Instead of treating discarded spacecraft as "space junk," we framed them as silent monuments and pioneers that paved the way for humanity. We carefully considered tone, accessibility for young audiences, and scientific accuracy—explaining real engineering concepts like thin Martian atmospheric density, rotor RPM requirements, and supersonic parachutes through an engaging, narrative format.
